steps.say: Raker finds class-action settlements you qualify for, files the claim by email, and tracks the reply live.
This is the live dashboard, backed by Convex with settlements discovered by a Firecrawl crawl of public settlement trackers.
Each row is a real open settlement with its provider, deadline, and eligibility summary, synced live with no polling.
Raker provisions its own dedicated AgentMail claims inbox, which sends the claim and receives the administrator's reply.
One click on File claim sends the email from Raker's inbox, and the claim appears below the settlement with its live status.
When the administrator replies, the webhook flips the status to confirmed or needs info. Discover, file, and track in one place.
